season: Feast (treated as feast of the Lord)
keyVerseDR: "Destroy this temple; and in three days I will raise it up." (Jn 2:19)

level1.title: God's House
level1.story: Jesus went to the Temple. People were selling animals there. Jesus drove them out and said, "Do not make My Father's house a market!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What is the name of your church?
How do you act in God's house?
level1.prayer: Jesus, make my heart Your home. Amen.

activity.title: Inside God's house
activity.intro: Draw the inside of your church: the altar, the tabernacle, and the cross.
activity.prompt: Inside my church: the altar, the tabernacle with its lamp, and the crucifix

level2.title: Zeal for Your House
level2.story: The Passover was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. In the Temple He found people selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and money changers at their tables. He made a whip of little cords and drove them all out, and overturned the tables. Jesus said, "Make not the house of My Father a house of traffic." He said, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up," speaking of the temple of His body.
level2.keyLine: Destroy this temple; and in three days I will raise it up.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does the whole world celebrate a church in Rome?
How are we 'living stones' of the Church?
level2.prayer: Lord, make me a living stone in Your Church. Amen.

activity.title: Around the altar
activity.intro: Match each item in God's house to where it is.
pairs: Where Jesus is kept in the Eucharist
